opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to bought tokens, blocked-token eligibility, and an activated mining process, while explicitly promoting multilevel development for bonuses. It also presents package-linked commissions, immediate mining, and a weekly earnings example of 16,000 euros, alongside a conditional one-year price forecast. The free-card process requests an address, date of birth, and credit-card name. Its Bitcoin comparison and scenario chart provide promotional context for these financial claims.
